resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Polish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Polish pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula-notation, technical-clarity, and SI-unit defects across circuit, Joule-heating, TCR, trigonometric, thermal, and SI content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Polish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm's-law relationship heading was too vague in Polish.
evidence: The previous heading was Związek.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the technical term Zależność.

findings.summary: The rearranged-formulas heading was a literal and unnatural Polish phrase.
evidence: The previous heading was Zmienione formuły.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Przekształcone wzory.

findings.summary: The zero-resistance warning used an awkward unit-first construction.
evidence: The previous text was Rezystancja zerowa Ω jest idealnym zwarciem i należy się z nią obchodzić osobno.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as resistance equal to zero being an ideal short circuit that needs separate treatment.

findings.summary: The resistance example title used the less precise word opór.
evidence: The previous title was Znajdź opór.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Oblicz rezystancję for consistency with the concept terminology.

findings.summary: The voltage example title used an imperative that was inconsistent with the other example labels.
evidence: The previous title was Znajdź napięcie.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Oblicz napięcie.

findings.summary: The kilo-ohm conversion did not use Polish thousands grouping.
evidence: The previous formula used 1 kΩ = 1000 Ω.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 1 kΩ = 1 000 Ω for consistent engineering notation.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating description used a literal loanword and called resistance opór.
evidence: The previous description used konwersję ... przez opór.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with zamianę energii and the precise term rezystancja.

findings.summary: The current definition used an unnatural Polish sentence structure.
evidence: The previous bullet was I jest prądem w amperach (A).
findings.resolution: Changed it to I to prąd wyrażony w amperach (A).

findings.summary: The heating-factor bullet used a literal transfer term and vague word for surrounding equipment.
evidence: The previous bullet began with Transfer ciepła do powietrza, cieczy i sprzętu.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as heat transfer to air, liquids, and surrounding components.

findings.summary: The explanatory paragraph used transfer as an English-derived noun and did not name heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous paragraph used szybkość transferu energii and strumień ciepła.
findings.resolution: Changed it to natural Polish and the more precise term gęstość strumienia ciepła.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms heading was translated as circuit conditions rather than terminology.
evidence: The previous heading was Warunki obwodu.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Terminy dotyczące obwodu.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description used an awkward plural construction for circuit nodes.
evidence: The previous description referred to węzłach obwodów.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as behavior at circuit nodes and around closed loops.

findings.summary: The KVL example formula retained an English-style decimal point in a Polish locale.
evidence: The previous expression began with +8.0 V.
findings.resolution: Changed the numeric notation to +8,0 V.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell statement used an awkward phrase for approximate summation.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with pojemność i dostępny prąd zwiększają się w przybliżeniu.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it to say that capacity and available current approximately add.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving bullet used the literal phrase równania jednoczesne.
evidence: The previous bullet said Rozwiąż równania jednoczesne i sprawdź bilans mocy.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the standard Polish term układ równań.

findings.summary: The TCR unit explanation said temperatures use a scale instead of being expressed in one.
evidence: The previous bullet was Temperatury muszą używać tej samej skali i jednostek.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to require the same temperature scale and compatible units for T - T_0.

findings.summary: The TCR example omitted conventional spacing in the coefficient units.
evidence: The previous formula used 400 × 10^-6 / °C and 0,0004 / °C without the locale's unit spacing convention.
findings.resolution: Normalized the coefficient formula notation to the Polish engineering style.

findings.summary: The TCR limitations paragraph used a literal phrase for material changes and an imprecise result comparison.
evidence: The previous paragraph used zmiany materiału and różnił się od szacunków.
findings.resolution: Clarified changes in material properties and the first-order estimate.

findings.summary: The trigonometry description used an unnatural verb for relating angles and lengths.
evidence: The previous description began with Trygonometria wiąże kąty i długości.
findings.resolution: Changed it to łączy kąty z długościami.

findings.summary: The degrees-and-radians guidance contained an unnecessary comma and a literal phrase for angle mode.
evidence: The previous paragraph used tryb prawidłowego kąta and placed a comma before daje.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as the correct angle mode and a full-turn statement.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity definition used a terse unit list without saying what C represents.
evidence: The previous bullet was C to pojemność cieplna w J/K lub J/°C.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as heat capacity expressed in J/K or J/°C.

findings.summary: The water-heating setup omitted standard spacing before degree symbols.
evidence: The previous setup used 20°C and 70°C.
findings.resolution: Changed the temperatures to 20 °C and 70 °C and added natural Polish punctuation.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating heading was unnecessarily wordy.
evidence: The previous heading was Ogrzewanie energią elektryczną.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise technical heading Ogrzewanie elektryczne.

findings.summary: The object-versus-material heading used an informal contrast word.
evidence: The previous heading was Przedmiot kontra materiał.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the neutral technical heading Obiekt a materiał.

findings.summary: The SI table heading called the entries typical units instead of identifying them as base units.
evidence: The previous heading was Typowe jednostki SI.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Jednostki podstawowe SI.
